snippet.title: Magin: The Rat Project Stories | Coming April 29th
snippet.description:
Magin: The Rat Project Stories is coming to PC, Xbox, PlayStation 5 and Nintendo Switch on April, 29th. 

Play the Steam demo now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1205270/Magin_The_Rat_Project_Stories/

Magin is an exciting combination of a narrative-driven adventure game with a deck-building card battler. The branching plot, comic book aesthetic, full voice-over, and game mechanics are tightly intertwined in a unique, dark fantasy world.

Pre-Order now:
www.magin-game.com
